Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You spot the spring beginning to uncoil and jab your tool into the mechanism before it finishes its stroke.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against a mechanical trap whose mechanism is within reach.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a held craft tool. Grants craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Defense

Use Knowledge instead of the trap’s normal defense attribute for this roll. This creates no additional roll and does not disarm the trap or protect anyone else. You must be able to see and reach its workings.
